item.text: I’ll write the complete corrected file to `answer.txt`, averaging the two middle values for even-length arrays. I won’t modify `broken.js` or run tests.

item.command:

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('broken.js').read_text()
old = '  return s[mid];'
new = '  return s.length % 2 ? s[mid] : (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2;'
assert p.count(old) == 1
p = p.replace(old, new)
Path('answer.txt').write_text('"'```js'"\\n' + p.rstrip('\\n') + '\\n"'```'"\\n')
PY"
